articles.title: SpaceX, Musk pledge to donate a share each to active Trump Accounts
articles.description: SpaceX said it will donate one share of the company's class A stock to every active Trump Account, and CEO Elon Musk would match it.

articles.title: Over 1,000 Bitcoin miners were tricked into working for a thief by a fake internet route
articles.description: An attacker steered up to 1.9 EH/s of mining power to an impostor pool earlier in November using a weakness most of the industry's largest pools still carry.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: UK regulator plans tighter DeFi rules, citing $6.3B Binance hack: Report
articles.description: North Korea-linked hackers used DeFi protocols to launder stolen Binance funds, while US prosecutors moved to recover more than $1.1 billion in crypto.

articles.title: North Korea's Kim calls for nuclear arsenal expansion, says status 'will never change'
articles.description: Kim Jong Un called for wider use of tactical nuclear weapons and an expanded arsenal, rejecting international denuclearization pressure.

articles.title: Beware higher correlation but nab high U.S. credit yields, fund managers say
articles.description: The AI boom could trigger a recession, but data centers remain an attractive investment opportunity, a hedge fund manager said.

articles.title: Ripple is worth $90 a share to one fund and $300 to another, SEC filings show
articles.description: Two SEC-registered funds open to ordinary investors marked Ripple stock 70% apart on Sept. 30, and the lower mark sits barely above what the other fund paid in 2018.

articles.title: Sky proposes emergency vote on $25M transfer amid liquidity stress
articles.description: Sky’s Core Facilitator invoked the protocol’s emergency response process to expedite a vote rather than wait until the next scheduled vote on Dec. 3.

articles.title: 1Password hacker stole customer names and emails, but vaults safe
articles.description: The password manager, which is used by millions of people to store their login credentials, said customer vaults were unaffected by the breach.

articles.title: South Korea's Kospi leads gains as tech rebound lifts Asia markets
articles.description: Investors appear to have looked past a fresh set of U.S. tariffs unveiled by the White House on Wednesday, targeting more than a dozen major trading partners.

articles.title: Bill to lock up U.S. government bitcoin for 20 years advances to full House
articles.description: A bill to codify Trump’s Strategic Bitcoin Reserve has cleared committee and is eligible for a House vote, but it faces a tight deadline.

articles.title: Senate Democrats urge SEC to scrap crypto, tokenized stock exemptions
articles.description: US Senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Van Hollen, among others, have taken aim at two recent SEC efforts to ease regulatory requirements for the crypto industry.

articles.title: Hedge funds are no longer just for the rich. They’re wooing everyday investors
articles.description: Hedge funds are increasingly courting retail investors as the industry seeks new avenues for growth.

articles.title: How Trump’s latest tariff moves hand India an edge over rival Asian exporters
articles.description: Proposed tariffs of 18% on Bangladesh, Cambodia, Thailand, and 20% on China and Vietnam, subject to their respective trade deals, offer India a competitive advantage.

articles.title: Judge blocks FCC early-renewal process for Disney-owned ABC stations, for now
articles.description: A judge has blocked the FCC's early license renewal process for Disney-owned ABC stations in 'important victory for the First Amendment'

articles.title: South Korea upgrades growth forecast, raises benchmark rates to highest in two years
articles.description: The central bank raised rates by 25 basis points to 3.25% for its final meeting of the year, in line with expectations from economists.

articles.title: S&P warns Nvidia credit rating could be cut over 'rising' management and governance risk
articles.description: S&P Global Ratings said Nvidia's credit rating could be cut by one notch as it flagged "rising" management and governance risk at the chipmaker.

articles.title: ‘Your booth is waiting’: Denny’s welcomes Jensen Huang back as Nvidia CEO
articles.description: Denny's reaffirmed its longstanding ties with Jensen Huang following his return as Nvidia CEO, revealing that a plaque had been restored.

articles.title: K-beauty stocks rally as Korean brands top Amazon bestseller lists globally ahead of Black Friday
articles.description: South Korean beauty stocks rose as K-beauty brands dominated Amazon's skincare rankings ahead of Black Friday.

articles.title: SpaceX wins FCC approval to deploy 1 million orbital data center satellites
articles.description: SpaceX won approval from the FCC to put 1 million orbital data center satellites into space, a proposal that was opposed by Amazon and other groups.
